aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.book: Craft a book with one amethyst dust for the Hex Notebook. Its diagrams show where to start each pattern and which way to draw.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.charge: Cyphers break when their charge runs out. Trinkets can be recharged. Artifacts can also draw on media in your inventory.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.cluster: Mine a fully grown amethyst cluster with a pickaxe without Silk Touch. It drops dust and can drop a charged amethyst. Fortune improves the chance of finding one.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.light: For your first light, stand in open space and carry amethyst dust. Open the grid with your staff.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.patterns: Draw Mind's Reflection, Compass' Purification, then Conjure Light. This places a light at eye level for one dust. Consult the Hex Notebook for the shapes.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.prepare: Open Prepared Abilities and assign the programmed item to a slot. Using the slot runs the program on that item and pays its normal cost.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.staff: Craft a staff with three sticks, a plank and a charged amethyst. Use it to open the drawing grid. All classes can draw patterns.
aeroscapes_reimagine.hex.info.write: Hold the empty implement opposite your staff. The matching Craft spell takes a dropped stack of media and a list of instructions. The offering supplies the initial charge.
